overlap_evidence.action: block-2 rows in the overlap window excluded as confirmed duplicate ingestion (block-1 copies retained)

reason_descriptions.EXC_DUP_OVERLAP: Confirmed duplicate ingestion: record repeated in the overlapping window of the two source blocks
reason_descriptions.EXC_DUP_WITHIN_SOURCE: Exact duplicate within a source block (only when drop_within_source_exact_duplicates is enabled)
reason_descriptions.EXC_NON_MERCHANDISE: Ledger or service line (postage, fees, manual entries, adjustments, vouchers, test codes)
reason_descriptions.QRN_MISSING_DESCRIPTION: Missing product description on a priced line
reason_descriptions.QRN_PARSE_FAILURE: A required field failed numeric/datetime/format parsing
reason_descriptions.QRN_STOCK_ADJUSTMENT: Negative quantity on a non-cancellation invoice (stock write-off / adjustment, no sale)
reason_descriptions.QRN_UNRECOGNISED_STOCKCODE: Stock code matches neither merchandise nor known non-merchandise patterns
reason_descriptions.QRN_ZERO_PRICE: Zero unit price (no revenue; free issue or unpriced adjustment)
